description.raw: '''Innate - Resonance:''' '''Ekko's''' [[File:Basic attack cursor icon.png|20px|link=Basic attack|An icon representing the keyword Basic attack]] [[:Basic attack|basic attacks]] [[File:On-hit icon.png|20px|link=Attack_effects#On_Hitting|An icon representing the keyword On-hit]] [[:Attack_effects#On_Hitting|on-hit]] and damaging [[File:Champion ability.svg|20px|link=Champion ability|An icon representing the keyword Champion ability]] [[:Champion ability|abilities]] apply a [[File:Stack icon.png|20px|link=Stack|An icon representing the keyword Stack]] [[:Stack|stack]] of ''Resonance'' to enemies hit for 4 seconds, refreshing on subsequent hits and stacking up to 3 times. The third stack consumes them all to deal 30 – 150 (based on level)[[Category:Debug]] (+ 80% AP) '''bonus''' magic damage. ''Z-Drive Resonance'' deals 270% damage against [[File:Monster icon.png|20px|link=Monster|An icon representing the keyword Monster]] [[:Monster|monsters]].
description.text: Innate - Resonance: Ekko's basic attacks on-hit and damaging abilities apply a stack of Resonance to enemies hit for 4 seconds, refreshing on subsequent hits and stacking up to 3 times. The third stack consumes them all to deal 30 – 150 (based on level)Category:Debug (+ 80% AP) bonus magic damage. Z-Drive Resonance deals 270% damage against monsters.

description2.raw: ''Resonance'' cannot affect the same target more than once every few seconds.
description2.text: Resonance cannot affect the same target more than once every few seconds.

description3.raw: '''Innate - Stolen Time:''' Triggering ''Resonance'' against a [[File:Champion icon.png|20px|link=Champion|An icon representing the keyword Champion]] [[:Champion|champion]] grants '''Ekko''' 50% / 60% / 70% / 80% (based on level) [[File:Movement speed icon.png|15px|link=Movement speed]] '''bonus''' movement speed for 2 / 2.5 / 3 (based on level) seconds.
description3.text: Innate - Stolen Time: Triggering Resonance against a champion grants Ekko 50% / 60% / 70% / 80% (based on level)  bonus movement speed for 2 / 2.5 / 3 (based on level) seconds.

notes.raw: * '''Ekko's''' basic attacks have different animations based on how many stacks his target has. His attack pattern is as follows: ** Downwards → Upwards → Sideways *** If the target has already been affected by ''Resonance'', '''Ekko's''' basic attack animations will kick or attack the target sideways. * ''Resonance'' stacks will not be applied nor consumed if the basic attack is [[File:Jax Counter Strike old.png|20px|link=Attack_effects#Parrying|An icon representing the keyword Dodge]] [[:Attack_effects#Parrying|dodged]] or [[File:Spirit's Refuge.png|20px|link=Attack_effects#Parrying|An icon representing the keyword Block]] [[:Attack_effects#Parrying|blocked]] or if the attack [[File:Blind icon.png|20px|link=Blind|An icon representing the keyword Blind]] [[:Blind|misses]].
notes.text:
Ekko's basic attacks have different animations based on how many stacks his target has. His attack pattern is as follows:
* Downwards → Upwards → Sideways
** If the target has already been affected by Resonance, Ekko's basic attack animations will kick or attack the target sideways.
Resonance stacks will not be applied nor consumed if the basic attack is dodged or blocked or if the attack misses.
